title: Gate/lifecycle cross-test's era-1 split 'pin' is a vacuous continue — no assertion would bite if the fixture's era-1 factor drifted below 1000
detail: Test comment (line 304) and PR body claim the era-1 split is 'pinned explicitly' in the cross-test, but this branch asserts nothing; the actual pin is test_legacy_predicate_and_decay_math's pipe_effective_capacity(cat,1,na)==10.
recommended_fix: Replace the continue with an explicit expectf(era==1: legacy && !decayed) so the documented split is asserted where claimed, or correct the comment/PR-body wording.
